episodes.title: Don't Say His Name
episodes.summary: Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to help Count Dracula buy a London house. Villagers warn him and give him a crucifix; a coachman with glowing eyes collects him at midnight.
episodes.cliffhanger: The coachman silences a pack of wolves with one gesture.

episodes.title: The Man With No Reflection
episodes.summary: The Count welcomes Jonathan. He never eats and is never seen by day. While shaving, Jonathan sees no reflection of the Count, who lunges at a drop of blood and recoils from the crucifix.
episodes.cliffhanger: Every door in the castle is locked. Jonathan is a prisoner.

episodes.title: The Women in the Moonlight
episodes.summary: Jonathan sees the Count crawl head-first down the castle wall. He falls asleep in a forbidden wing and wakes to three vampire women; the Count stops them and claims Jonathan.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Count isn't saving Jonathan. He is saving him for later.

episodes.title: Where the Count Sleeps
episodes.summary: Jonathan climbs down the wall into a crypt and finds the Count lying in a box of earth, gorged with blood. He strikes with a shovel; fifty boxes leave for London.
episodes.cliffhanger: The boxes leave for London, and Jonathan is left behind with the three women.

episodes.title: She Was Next
episodes.summary: Mina waits for Jonathan while staying with Lucy in Whitby. Lucy accepts Arthur over Dr. Seward and Quincey Morris, and starts sleepwalking. A storm brings a ship.
episodes.cliffhanger: A ship is driven toward Whitby by a terrible storm.

episodes.title: The Ship With No Crew
episodes.summary: The Demeter runs aground with its dead captain tied to the wheel. A huge dog leaps ashore. The log tells of sailors vanishing one by one; the cargo is fifty boxes of earth.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Count has arrived in England.

episodes.title: Something on the Bench
episodes.summary: Lucy sleepwalks to the clifftop churchyard. Mina sees a dark figure with red eyes bending over her. Lucy is alone when Mina arrives, with two tiny marks on her throat.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mina blames a pin for the marks. She is wrong.

episodes.title: The Man Who Eats Flies
episodes.summary: Dr. Seward's patient Renfield eats flies, spiders and birds, and senses his Master at Carfax next door. Mina finds Jonathan in a Budapest hospital and marries him. Lucy is dying in London.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lucy is dying, and no one knows why.

episodes.title: The Professor's Warning
episodes.summary: Lucy is wasting away. Dr. Seward calls Professor Van Helsing, who finds terrible blood loss. Arthur gives blood; Van Helsing fills her room with garlic flowers, which her mother throws away.
episodes.cliffhanger: The window is opened, and the garlic is gone.

episodes.title: That Wasn't Lucy
episodes.summary: A wolf smashes Lucy's window and her mother dies of fright. Dying, Lucy's teeth grow sharp and she begs Arthur for a kiss; Van Helsing stops him. Lucy dies.
episodes.cliffhanger: Van Helsing says Lucy's death is only the beginning.

episodes.title: The Lady in White
episodes.summary: Newspapers report children lured away at night by a lady in white and found with throat wounds. Van Helsing and Seward find Lucy's coffin empty and see her carrying a child.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lucy returns from the dark with blood on her lips.

episodes.title: The Hardest Goodbye
episodes.summary: Van Helsing brings Arthur, Quincey and Seward to the tomb. Undead Lucy calls to Arthur but is driven back by a crucifix and the sealed door. Arthur drives the stake and Lucy finds peace.
episodes.cliffhanger: Now they know what they are hunting.

episodes.title: Fifty Coffins
episodes.summary: Jonathan and Mina join the hunters. Jonathan has seen the Count, younger, in London. Mina compiles every record; the Count must rest in his fifty boxes of earth hidden around London. The men leave Mina out.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mina wakes paler every morning.

episodes.title: The House of Rats
episodes.summary: The men break into Carfax and seal the boxes with holy bread; thousands of rats swarm until Arthur's terriers drive them off. Renfield, refused his release, is found broken in his cell.
episodes.cliffhanger: Renfield's last words change everything.

episodes.title: Unclean
episodes.summary: Dying, Renfield confesses he let the Count in to visit Mina. The men break into the Harkers' room to find the Count forcing Mina to drink his blood; he escapes as mist.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mina cries out that she is unclean.

episodes.title: One Box Left
episodes.summary: Holy bread burns a scar onto Mina's forehead. The men destroy box after box and ambush the Count in Piccadilly; Jonathan's knife slashes his coat and gold spills out, but he escapes.
episodes.cliffhanger: One box of earth is still missing.

episodes.title: Through His Eyes
episodes.summary: Mina asks Van Helsing to hypnotise her at dawn. In a trance she senses the Count: dark water and creaking chains. He is on the ship Czarina Catherine, fleeing home.
episodes.cliffhanger: The link works both ways.

episodes.title: One Step Ahead
episodes.summary: The ship docks secretly at another port and the Count's box is carried upriver. The hunters split up: Jonathan and Arthur by steam launch, Seward and Quincey on horseback, Van Helsing and Mina by carriage to the castle.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mina is changing, and the three sisters are waiting.

episodes.title: The Circle in the Snow
episodes.summary: Near the castle Van Helsing draws a circle of holy bread around Mina. The three women call to her but cannot cross. At dawn he enters the castle, destroys the women and seals the Count's tomb.
episodes.cliffhanger: A wagon carrying the last box races toward the castle.

episodes.title: Sunset
episodes.summary: At sunset the hunters converge on the wagon. Quincey is wounded. Jonathan cuts the Count's throat and Quincey stabs his heart; the Count turns to dust, Mina's scar vanishes, and Quincey dies smiling.
episodes.cliffhanger: Years later, the Harkers name their son Quincey.
